pr_title: [3.x] Fix crash on `get_joy_button_index_from_string` and `get_joy_axis_index_from_string` for non-existing key
pr_comments:
> When iterating over them, adding check for nullptr and early-quit is also considerable.

I would add this too to be safe. Someone might think in the future that the `String()` constructor is redundant and remove it, reintroducing the crash. So guarding against the actual unnecessary comparison is safer.

@akien-mga It seems that `_joy_buttons` and `_joy_axes` limited its length with their max enum value.
```c++
static const char *_joy_buttons[(size_t)JoyButton::SDL_MAX] = {
	"a",
	"b",
	"x",
	"y",
	"back",
	"guide",
	"start",
	"leftstick",
	"rightstick",
	"leftshoulder",
	"rightshoulder",
	"dpup",
	"dpdown",
	"dpleft",
	"dpright",
	"misc1",
	"paddle1",
	"paddle2",
	"paddle3",
	"paddle4",
	"touchpad",
};
static const char *_joy_axes[(size_t)JoyAxis::SDL_MAX] = {
	"leftx",
	"lefty",
	"rightx",
	"righty",
	"lefttrigger",
	"righttrigger",
};
```
`JoyButton::SDL_MAX` and `JoyAxis::SDL_MAX` are exactly matched with the length of each array.
Do we also need to add an additional `nullptr` check for them?

issue_context.title: Passing nonexisting button name to Input.get_joy_button_index_from_string crashes Godot 3.4.3
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

3.4.3-stable

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Passing a string which isn't one of valid joy button names to the Input.get_joy_button_index_from_string causes a crash.

### Steps to reproduce

Create or open the project and try to execute this line of code:
`Input.get_joy_button_index_from_string("ThisWillCrash")`

### Minimal reproduction project

[InputGetButton.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8256755/InputGetButton.zip)
comments:
I can confirm this on `3.x` 6073277ccac5931cf5332e75a17c2a691e6da12d (Linux).

`get_joy_button_index_from_string()` seems to have been removed in `master` by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/43591, so the fix should be made on the `3.x` branch.

This is caused by comparing equality between `String` and `nullptr`.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6073277ccac5931cf5332e75a17c2a691e6da12d/main/input_default.cpp#L1341

There are two solutions:

1. Checking for `nullptr` locally. `_buttons[i] && p_button == _buttons[i]`
2. Fix `String` comparation with null pointer. Constructing `String` from `nullptr` is already allowed.

Not sure which one suits "Prefer local solutions" :confused:
